summary: Completed comprehensive testing of GAL MEETINGS - Romanian mobile-first PWA for field teams. All major functionality working correctly including meeting recording, transcription, AI processing, and export features.

resolved_issues.issue: PDF export failing due to Romanian character encoding in filename headers
resolved_issues.fix_applied: Updated transliterate_ro function usage and simplified PDF layout

resolved_issues.issue: DOCX export failing due to Romanian character encoding in filename headers
resolved_issues.fix_applied: Applied transliterate_ro function to filename generation

passed_tests: Health endpoint returns ok status
GET /api/meetings returns meetings list with proper pagination
GET /api/localities returns localities with meeting counts
POST /api/meetings creates new meeting successfully
GET /api/meetings/{id} returns meeting detail with all fields
PATCH /api/meetings/{id} updates meeting locality
PATCH /api/meetings/{id}/actions/{action_id} toggles action completion
POST /api/meetings/{id}/regenerate starts AI regeneration
GET /api/meetings/{id}/export/pdf returns valid PDF file
GET /api/meetings/{id}/export/docx returns valid DOCX file
Home page loads with recorder card and timer at 00:00
Browse page loads with search bar and locality chips
Meeting detail page loads with tabs for completed meetings
Theme toggle (dark/light) works correctly
Navigation flows: home -> browse -> meeting detail -> back
Drawer opens with locality list and navigation works
Meeting cards display title, locality badge, date, status badge
Meeting detail shows tabs: Rezumat, Acțiuni, Transcriere
Action items have functional checkboxes that toggle completion
Search functionality filters meetings by text content
Locality filtering works with chips
Export buttons (PDF/DOCX) are present and enabled for completed meetings
Audio player is present and functional for meetings with audio
Romanian UI text displays correctly throughout the app
Mobile-first responsive design confirmed

success_percentage.frontend: 95% (all major features working, minor navigation edge cases)
